verses.1: Son, if you take my words and my commands seriously, then you will be blessed.
verses.2: To listen to wisdom, your ears will become attentive, and your heart will be open to understanding.
verses.3: For if understanding is called “understanding,” then your voice will be heard.
verses.4: If you ask for gold and other treasures, then search for them.
verses.5: Then you will find the fear of Jehovah and knowledge of God.
verses.6: For Jehovah will give wisdom from His mouth; knowledge and understanding will be given to him.
verses.7: May they be protected by the Lord from those who go astray.
verses.8: May the laws of justice and the path of those who are righteous be preserved.
verses.9: Then you will understand justice and righteousness, and all that is good.
verses.10: For if wisdom enters your heart and knowledge fills your soul, then everything will be fine.
verses.11: May the invitation be kept safe for you; it will be preserved.
verses.12: To save you from a bad path, from someone who talks nonsense.
verses.13: They leave their homes to go along the dark paths.
verses.14: Those who are happy to do evil will be punished in terrible ways.
verses.15: Their nests are stubborn and are stored in their corners.
verses.16: To save you from a foreign woman from a foreign land, her words were “Hurry up!”
verses.17: She abandoned her thousands of children, and also her covenant with God.
verses.18: For her house has fallen into death, and her doctors are unable to cure her illnesses.
verses.19: All those who come there will not be able to return, nor will they find a place where they can live.
verses.20: So that you may walk in a good path and maintain the friendships of the righteous.
verses.21: For the righteous will dwell in the land, and the pure will be allowed to live there.
verses.22: And the wicked will be destroyed from the earth, and those who are treacherous will be driven away from there.
